svg.title: ORM v6.11.0, Embedded Prisma Studio, Rust-free ORM for MySQL in Preview & More
svg.desc: A three-row editorial table on light paper listing the databases that Prisma ORM v6.11.0 moved to the Rust-free query compiler in Preview — MySQL/MariaDB, Neon and CockroachDB — each with its driver adapter package. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, cyan accent.
